scope: G004 QA/red-team — subagent-spawn primitive (task/spawn.rs) behavior-preservation proof

tests_added.note: The primitive's own pre-existing test module already fully covered case 1 (every SubagentSpawnParams field asserted against the mapped SubagentRequest/SubagentRuntimeOverrides field, plus id passthrough-when-Some and generate-when-None). This QA pass added case 2 (per-site field-profile snapshots) directly reachable via public SubagentSpawnParams construction; per-site params are not otherwise exposed as a separate testable seam, so the snapshots reconstruct each site's exact literal profile read from advisor/mod.rs, bounty.rs, research.rs, and task/mod.rs source.

cases.name: primitive_field_mapping
cases.expected: Every SubagentSpawnParams field (id Some/None, prompt, description, subagent_type, parent_session_id, parent_prompt_id, resume_from, cwd, model, model_override_provenance, reasoning_effort, persona, capability_mode, isolation, harness_agent_type, run_in_background, surface_completion, fork_context, advisor_gate_prevalidated) maps to the exact corresponding SubagentRequest / SubagentRuntimeOverrides field with no transformation.

cases.name: per_site_snapshot
cases.expected: Each of the 4 call sites' exact SubagentSpawnParams literal profile (read from source: advisor ReadOnly/fork_context=true/surface_completion=true/Harness provenance/run_in_background=false; bounty cwd=Some/isolation=param/surface_completion=false/fork_context=false/Harness provenance/capability_mode=None; research subagent_type="deep-research"/ReadOnly/all boolean flags false/Harness provenance/cwd=None; task Tool provenance/fork_context=is_advisor_subagent(subagent_type) checked true and false/surface_completion=true always) survives into_request() unchanged.

cases.name: regression_suites
cases.expected: All pre-existing regression suites for the 4 migrated call sites, plus the primitive module and the schema-sync fixture test, pass unmodified.

cases.name: schema_toolkind_kinds
cases.expected: schema/tool_meta.schema.json ToolKind description contains 'advisor', 'research', and 'bounty', and still contains pre-existing kinds like 'task' and 'read'; the fixture test tool_meta_schema_is_up_to_date (which regenerates the schema from CanonicalToolMeta and compares) passes, proving the checked-in file is in sync with the type.
cases.evidence: definitions.ToolKind.description in schema/tool_meta.schema.json lists: … "task", "advisor", "research", "bounty", … "read" (as part of the '(Rust deserializes them to `other` …). Known values: `read`, …' string) — all required tokens present.
